2.name: Canonical Leo program and secure commitments

blockedItems.problem: Reward Escrow upgrade code and tests are complete, but the upgraded Program has not been manually broadcast.
blockedItems.evidence: Local Leo 4.0.2 build now exposes fund_bounty, lock_reward, release_reward, refund_bounty, bounty_escrows, claim_payouts, bounty_claim_counts, and claim_reporters; deployed Testnet Program still requires a manual upgrade before wallet escrow actions are enabled.
attemptsMade: Inspected the deployed-compatible ABI and canonical Leo source.
Implemented a read-only capability boundary that disables wallet actions and refuses API writes without parsing a body.
Implemented Credits escrow upgrade code in the canonical Leo Program without changing existing public entry signatures.
Added local ABI, source guard, valid flow, invalid actor, rejected claim, overdraft, duplicate payout, and malicious refund tests.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: A compatible Program upgrade, user wallet signature, Testnet fee, and Testnet Credits are required; Codex must not broadcast the upgrade or handle private keys.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: Blocks real RewardLocked/Paid acceptance, on-chain triage, Testnet payout, and final P1 acceptance.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: Compatibility design, Leo code, local ABI tests, disabled-action UI, and public capability reporting are complete.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Explicitly approve a Program upgrade design, then sign the upgrade and subsequent escrow transactions in Leo Wallet.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: An upgraded Program is confirmed on Testnet and its escrow mappings are verified.

blockedItems.problem: No ciphertext object storage or delivery provider is configured.
blockedItems.evidence: Local ECDH/HKDF/AES-GCM export/import, package hashing, wrong-key rejection, tamper rejection, and public-only store attestation all pass tests.
attemptsMade: Implemented local owner-key generation and Whitehat encryption.
Implemented local package export/import and integrity-checked decryption without browser persistence or network transport.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: Cloud ciphertext delivery requires an external storage service and access policy.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: The local encrypted disclosure workflow works, but cross-device ciphertext delivery is not accepted.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: Local cryptographic workflow and public package-hash state are complete.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Choose and configure a ciphertext storage/delivery provider with owner-only read access.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: A configured provider passes upload, owner download, integrity, wrong-key, and plaintext-log tests.

blockedItems.problem: The deployed Program has no on-chain triage entries or mappings.
blockedItems.evidence: The triage capability reports BlockedByRewardEscrowUpgrade, refuses writes, and treats Role Switcher as Demo-only.
attemptsMade: Defined the required Program entries and mapping boundary.
Added authority and UI tests requiring self.signer, confirmed transactions, and verified mappings.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: On-chain triage depends on the Iteration 12 Program upgrade and escrow state.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: RewardLocked, disclosure, patched, paid, and rejected states remain local Demo workflow states.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: The disabled Real Mode boundary and authorization tests are complete.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Complete and confirm the compatible Reward Escrow and triage Program upgrade.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: Iteration 12 is completed and triage entries/mappings are deployed and queryable.

blockedItems.problem: No real AI model provider is configured.
blockedItems.evidence: The API accepts only the strict public metadata allowlist and returns 503 instead of silently using a local rules response.
attemptsMade: Implemented a provider interface and strict input/output sanitizer.
Added rate limits, bounded JSON parsing, immutable public-only scope text, and non-authoritative recommendation tests.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: A real model endpoint and external provider configuration are required.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: Real AI recommendations are unavailable; the local policy engine remains explicitly labeled Mock.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: Privacy, schema, rate-limit, and authority boundaries are complete.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Select and configure an external model provider without exposing private fields.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: A real provider passes public-only payload, output-scope, failure, and rate-limit acceptance.

blockedItems.problem: Production deployment is live, but Leo Wallet extension connection, reject, wrong-network, locked-wallet, and cancel-signature states still require manual browser acceptance.
blockedItems.evidence: Production deployment dpl_HTKyFiXTZwT83qBz73ji9Ghzp1nW is READY at https://aleo-gilt.vercel.app; deployment API is verified, registries read real Aleo mappings, /api/aleo/prove returns 410, escrow is gated, and 390px CDP checks show no overflow, runtime exception, or console error.
attemptsMade: Verified the linked Vercel project and existing deployments.
Deployed the current workspace to Vercel Production after explicit user approval.
Fixed deployment API status handling for real Program and deployment transaction endpoints.
Added public wallet diagnostic labels for adapter, address, expected network, error categories, and transaction preview readiness.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: Leo Wallet extension states require the user to operate a real Chrome or Edge extension session; Codex must not approve wallet prompts or broadcast transactions.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: Iteration 18 cannot be marked completed until normal connect, reject, locked, wrong network, reconnect, preview, and cancel-signature flows pass in a real wallet browser.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: Production APIs, registry reads, 390px layout, console checks, and disabled escrow gate are accepted.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Run the provided online wallet acceptance checklist in Chrome or Edge with Leo Wallet installed.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: The user reports all wallet checklist items passed without broadcasting any new transaction.

blockedItems.problem: Final protocol acceptance cannot pass while P0 submit_claim/replay acceptance and P1 escrow/triage/payout remain incomplete.
blockedItems.evidence: The live Testnet public index contains one Mapping Verified create_bounty and zero submit_claim transactions; the deployed ABI has no escrow or triage mappings.
attemptsMade: Re-ran the full 176-test, lint, build, browser, privacy, secret, dependency, and live Testnet registry checks.
Revisited every P0 and P1 blocker and confirmed each manual or upgrade dependency.
blockedItems.whyItCannotContinue: Wallet signatures, Testnet fees, a Program upgrade, Credits funding, and external ciphertext delivery cannot be performed by Codex.
blockedItems.dependencyImpact: The project cannot be described as a complete privacy-preserving bounty protocol yet.
blockedItems.safeWorkThatCanContinue: The existing Testnet bounty registry, device wallet boundary, Mock demo, local disclosure crypto, security hardening, and UI remain runnable.
blockedItems.requiredManualAction: Resume Iteration 7 first, then approve Iteration 8 and the compatible Iteration 12/14 Program upgrade workflow.
blockedItems.resumeCondition: All P0 and P1 public transactions and mappings are confirmed and independently verified.

iteration9Acceptance.standaloneBrowserWasmProver: not integrated; wallet execution is the device boundary
